<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def snap(a):
    al=a.split('\n')
    def box(ch,r0=0,r1=64,c0=0,c1=64):
        rs=[];cs=[]
        for r in range(r0,r1):
            for c in range(c0,c1):
                if al[r][c]==ch: rs.append(r);cs.append(c)
        return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)) if rs else None
    # N piece in play area (rows 30-45)
    nrs=[];ncs=[]
    for r in range(30,46):
        for c in range(30,50):
            if al[r][c]=='N': nrs.append(r);ncs.append(c)
    ndot=None
    for r in range(64):
        for c in range(64):
            if al[r][c]=='r' and ((c>0 and al[r][c-1]=='N') or (c<63 and al[r][c+1]=='N')):
                ndot=(r,c)
    return {
        'O':box('O',35,45,0,45),
        'S':box('S',35,45,0,45),
        'Y':box('Y',30,45,25,45),
        'N':(min(nrs),max(nrs),min(ncs),max(ncs)) if nrs else None,
        'ndot':ndot
    }
base=snap(current_frame.ascii)
print("base",base)
for (r,c,name) in [(57,6,'O-left'),(57,19,'S-left'),(57,25,'S-right'),(57,35,'Y-left'),(57,41,'Y-right'),(57,51,'N-left')]:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    s=snap(current_frame.ascii)
    diff={k:(base[k],s[k]) for k in s if s[k]!=base[k]}
    print(name, "changed" if diff else "NO", diff)
    # reset base to current so each probe is independent? No - keep base fixed to see cumulative. 
    # Actually reset base to current to isolate each cell's effect:
    base=s
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
